Good to hear it's working. I saved a note to the project's EngramDB memory: newer wkhtmltopdf versions need `--enable-local-file-access` for the invoice PDF tests to pass. That way it will come up if those tests break again after an upgrade or on a fresh machine.

If your fix is only in your local setup, you may want to commit the flag where the tests call wkhtmltopdf, so CI and other developers don't run into the same failure.
